nodes.label: Upscale Brunch Spread – Flat-Lay of Multiple Dishes
nodes.description: Overhead flat-lay of four plated brunch dishes on a dark textured surface. Dishes include: (1) Belgian-style waffles on a wooden serving board topped with whipped cream, fresh blueberries, powdered sugar, and maple syrup; (2) a savory open-faced dish with melted cheese drizzle, caramelized mushrooms/onions, and served with baked muffins and a dipping sauce; (3) a dish featuring a granola or nut crumble topping with a drizzled rose/pink sauce and powdered sugar; and (4) a partial fourth dish with cream or egg topping visible at the edge. Presentation style is moody, dark-background professional food photography — upscale casual dining aesthetic intended for restaurant website brunch menu promotion.
nodes.presentation_style: Overhead flat-lay, dark moody food photography
nodes.purpose: Restaurant website food showcase – brunch menu promotion
